en.text: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 撒母耳年纪老迈，就立他儿子作以色列的士师。

zhTraditional.text: 撒母耳年紀老邁，就立他兒子作以色列的士師。

en.text: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.

zhSimplified.text: 长子名叫约珥，次子名叫亚比亚；他们在别是巴作士师。

zhTraditional.text: 長子名叫約珥，次子名叫亞比亞；他們在別是巴作士師。

en.text: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.

zhSimplified.text: 他儿子不行他的道，贪图财利，收受贿赂，屈枉正直。

zhTraditional.text: 他兒子不行他的道，貪圖財利，收受賄賂，屈枉正直。

en.text: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列的长老都聚集，来到拉玛见撒母耳，

zhTraditional.text: 以色列的長老都聚集，來到拉瑪見撒母耳，

en.text: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”

zhSimplified.text: 对他说：「你年纪老迈了，你儿子不行你的道。现在求你为我们立一个王治理我们，像列国一样。」

zhTraditional.text: 對他說：「你年紀老邁了，你兒子不行你的道。現在求你為我們立一個王治理我們，像列國一樣。」

en.text: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 撒母耳不喜悦他们说「立一个王治理我们」，他就祷告耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 撒母耳不喜悅他們說「立一個王治理我們」，他就禱告耶和華。

en.text: The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「百姓向你说的一切话，你只管依从；因为他们不是厌弃你，乃是厌弃我，不要我作他们的王。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對撒母耳說：「百姓向你說的一切話，你只管依從；因為他們不是厭棄你，乃是厭棄我，不要我作他們的王。

en.text: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.

zhSimplified.text: 自从我领他们出埃及到如今，他们常常离弃我，事奉别神。现在他们向你所行的，是照他们素来所行的。

zhTraditional.text: 自從我領他們出埃及到如今，他們常常離棄我，事奉別神。現在他們向你所行的，是照他們素來所行的。

en.text: Now therefore, listen to their voice. However, you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”

zhSimplified.text: 故此你要依从他们的话，只是当警戒他们，告诉他们将来那王怎样管辖他们。」

zhTraditional.text: 故此你要依從他們的話，只是當警戒他們，告訴他們將來那王怎樣管轄他們。」

en.text: Samuel told all the LORD’s words to the people who asked him for a king.

zhSimplified.text: 撒母耳将耶和华的话都传给求他立王的百姓，说：

zhTraditional.text: 撒母耳將耶和華的話都傳給求他立王的百姓，說：

en.text: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.

zhSimplified.text: 「管辖你们的王必这样行：他必派你们的儿子为他赶车、跟马，奔走在车前；

zhTraditional.text: 「管轄你們的王必這樣行：他必派你們的兒子為他趕車、跟馬，奔走在車前；

en.text: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.

zhSimplified.text: 又派他们作千夫长、五十夫长，为他耕种田地，收割庄稼，打造军器和车上的器械；

zhTraditional.text: 又派他們作千夫長、五十夫長，為他耕種田地，收割莊稼，打造軍器和車上的器械；

en.text: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.

zhSimplified.text: 必取你们的女儿为他制造香膏，做饭烤饼；

zhTraditional.text: 必取你們的女兒為他製造香膏，做飯烤餅；

en.text: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.

zhSimplified.text: 也必取你们最好的田地、葡萄园、橄榄园赐给他的臣仆。

zhTraditional.text: 也必取你們最好的田地、葡萄園、橄欖園賜給他的臣僕。

en.text: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.

zhSimplified.text: 你们的粮食和葡萄园所出的，他必取十分之一给他的太监和臣仆；

zhTraditional.text: 你們的糧食和葡萄園所出的，他必取十分之一給他的太監和臣僕；

en.text: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.

zhSimplified.text: 又必取你们的仆人婢女，健壮的少年人和你们的驴，供他的差役。

zhTraditional.text: 又必取你們的僕人婢女，健壯的少年人和你們的驢，供他的差役。

en.text: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.

zhSimplified.text: 你们的羊群他必取十分之一，你们也必作他的仆人。

zhTraditional.text: 你們的羊群他必取十分之一，你們也必作他的僕人。

en.text: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and the LORD will not answer you in that day.”

zhSimplified.text: 那时你们必因所选的王哀求耶和华，耶和华却不应允你们。」

zhTraditional.text: 那時你們必因所選的王哀求耶和華，耶和華卻不應允你們。」

en.text: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,

zhSimplified.text: 百姓竟不肯听撒母耳的话，说：「不然！我们定要一个王治理我们，

zhTraditional.text: 百姓竟不肯聽撒母耳的話，說：「不然！我們定要一個王治理我們，

en.text: that we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”

zhSimplified.text: 使我们像列国一样，有王治理我们，统领我们，为我们争战。」

zhTraditional.text: 使我們像列國一樣，有王治理我們，統領我們，為我們爭戰。」

en.text: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 撒母耳听见百姓这一切话，就将这话陈明在耶和华面前。

zhTraditional.text: 撒母耳聽見百姓這一切話，就將這話陳明在耶和華面前。

en.text: The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Everyone go to your own city.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「你只管依从他们的话，为他们立王。」撒母耳对以色列人说：「你们各归各城去吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對撒母耳說：「你只管依從他們的話，為他們立王。」撒母耳對以色列人說：「你們各歸各城去吧！」
